risks.name: Theft, burglary and vandalism
risks.reason: Stock, cash and equipment kept on the premises can be stolen or damaged by intruders or vandals. (based on: goods, cash handling and pos system)

risks.name: Employee theft or fraud
risks.reason: Staff with access to cash and stock have the opportunity to steal or falsify records. (based on: 5 employees, cash handling and goods)

risks.name: Forced closure after premises damage
risks.reason: If the premises cannot be used after an incident, trading stops because there is no alternative site. (based on: a single location and physical premises)

risks.name: Customer or visitor injury on premises
risks.reason: Customers and visitors on the premises can be hurt by slips, trips or falls. (based on: customers visiting the premises and physical premises)

risks.name: Customer data breach
risks.reason: Customer details collected and stored by the business can be stolen or exposed in a breach. (based on: stored customer data and online orders)

risks.name: Payment fraud and chargebacks
risks.reason: Card and online payments are targets for fraud, stolen cards and false disputes. (based on: card payments and online orders)

risks.name: Ransomware or system outage
risks.reason: Sales that depend on digital systems stop if those systems are locked by an attack or go offline. (based on: pos system and online orders)

risks.name: Flood, storm and water damage
risks.reason: Premises, stock and equipment can be damaged by flooding, storms or burst pipes. (based on: goods)

risks.name: Loss or damage of goods in delivery
risks.reason: Goods sent to customers can be lost, spoiled or damaged on the way, outside the business's control. (based on: online orders)

risks.name: Equipment breakdown
risks.reason: Daily work depends on key machinery and systems, so a breakdown stops work and can be costly to repair. (based on: pos system)

risks.name: Employee injury at work
risks.reason: Staff working with heat, sharp tools or heavy lifting can be hurt by burns, cuts, slips or strains. (based on: 5 employees)

risks.name: Power, gas or water outage
risks.reason: Cooking, cold storage and sales systems cannot run without power, gas or water, so an outage halts work. (based on: pos system)

risks.name: Harm caused by products sold
risks.reason: A faulty or unsafe product that has been sold can injure a customer. (based on: hardware and goods)

risks.name: Electrical fire
risks.reason: Equipment that runs for long hours puts constant load on the electrical system, and faults can start a fire. (assumed for a retail shop; no matching details were provided)

summary.headline: 14 risks checked, 14 potential gaps: 7 had no policy wording found and 7 need checking.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Customer data breach
findings.explanation: No policy wording covers customer data breaches. Your stored customer details and online orders could be stolen, but the policy doesn't address this risk.
findings.recommendation: Ask your insurer if they cover data breaches for customer information.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Forced closure after premises damage
findings.explanation: No policy wording covers forced closure after premises damage. If your shop can't operate due to damage, the policy doesn't protect against trading stops.
findings.recommendation: Check with your insurer if they cover business interruption from physical damage.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Payment fraud and chargebacks
findings.explanation: No policy wording covers payment fraud or chargebacks. Card and online payments could be stolen or disputed without coverage.
findings.recommendation: Ask your insurer if they cover payment fraud for card transactions.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Ransomware or system outage
findings.explanation: No policy wording covers ransomware or system outages. If your POS or online systems stop working, the policy doesn't protect sales.
findings.recommendation: Check with your insurer if they cover system outages affecting sales.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Employee injury at work
findings.explanation: No policy wording addresses employee injuries from tasks like handling heat, sharp tools, or heavy lifting. This means staff could get hurt without coverage.
findings.recommendation: Ask your insurer if they cover work-related injuries for employees handling physical tasks.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Equipment breakdown
findings.explanation: No policy wording covers equipment breakdowns for essential systems like the point-of-sale device. This could stop your business operations without coverage.
findings.recommendation: Check with your insurer if equipment breakdowns for key business systems are included.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Power, gas or water outage
findings.explanation: This is a relevant risk for a retail shop. Why it matters: Cooking, cold storage and sales systems cannot run without power, gas or water, so an outage halts work. (based on: pos system). No policy wording about this risk was found in the documents analysed, so this is a potential gap. Check this with your insurer or broker before making decisions.
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker about business interruption (loss of profits) cover, because no policy wording for this risk was found.

findings.title: Needs checking: Employee theft or fraud
findings.explanation: Policy wording related to this risk was found (page 2 of policy POL-c57f229d4bb8), but it does not clearly say whether this risk is included. What the analysis found: Relevant policy evidence was retrieved, but semantic interpretation is unavailable. Check this with your insurer or broker before making decisions.
findings.recommendation: Ask your insurer or broker to confirm in writing whether this risk is included, and ask about employer's liability or workmen's compensation cover.
